title: HKMC
description: HKMC is a Minecraft server running since 2023, built for players who want real challenge and community.
body:
HKMC is a Minecraft server running since 2023, built for players who want real challenge and community. 

- Lifesteal: Kill players to steal their hearts. Last heart standing wins. PvP-focused and high stakes.
- Survival: Grind, build, and team up in classic survival with a stable economy, claims, and player shops.
- Anarchy: No rules, no resets, true chaos. Raid, grief, hack clients allowed. Only the strongest survive.
- CPVP:  Crystal PvP focused arenas and kits. Competitive combat with custom mechanics for serious PvPers.

Community : 
Made for Malayalis, Bengali, English, Hindi, and Nepali speaking players. Active staff from all regions, so you can get help in your own language. Cross-cultural community with events, tournaments, and giveaways.

*Why HKMC:*
- Active since 2023 with consistent uptime
- Low ping for Indian & South Asian players  
- Anti-cheat + fair moderation, except Anarchy
- Discord + in-game chat bridges for all languages
- Regular updates, seasons, and battlepass

Join Us : Build empires, raid enemies, and survive the hardcore way with friends from Kerala to Nepal
